data.name: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
data.detailed_description:
Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing simulation game rooted in real Taiwan-style angling logic.

You play as an angler, starting from urban waterways and gradually exploring distinctive fishing spots across the country. Each fishing trip is a complete strategic preparation—you must carefully match rods, line sets, hooks, floats, and baits based on your target species and water conditions. Float-tuning, bottom detection, bite-reading—every step tests your understanding of the fish.

Authentic Angling Simulation
The game deeply simulates the core logic of Taiwan-style fishing: high-to-low float tuning, sensitivity switching, bait state adjustment, and line setup matching. This is not a simple "cast and wait" game—it requires you to make real-time decisions based on changing fish behavior.

Rich Equipment System
From budget rods to premium flagship models, from sleeve hooks to Qianyū hooks—dozens of rods, line sets, hooks, floats, and baits are available for free combination. Different setups suit different fish conditions. Every combination is a new experiment.

Immersive Fishing Experience
Fresh hand-painted 2D art style, combined with realistic float movements, bite feedback, and natural ambient sound effects—bringing the calm and focus of riverside fishing to your screen.

Exploration & Collection
Unlock diverse fishing locations—from urban canals to Shengzhong Lake, each with unique fish species, water conditions, and weather patterns. Complete your fish collection, keep your own fishing log, and leave your angling memories behind.

Gear up, and cast your line. The stories beneath the surface await.
